messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for hosted-api.us-west-2 — 502/504 + upstream timeouts. Aggregated failure rate ~14% over last 5m. Paging on-call team.

alice.k: grabbing it. seeing a spike in gateway 502s from edge-proxy -> inference-router. 95th latency normal but error rate up.

bob_sre: can you paste a quick histogram or TC? I don't see traces for many of these failed requests. sampling looks low.

charlie-prod: customers reporting slow responses and errors in their user-facing flows. Support queue has 6 threads flagged "API errors". Dana, can you confirm customers?

dana-support: confirmed — two mid-market customers (acme and zephyr) started receiving 502s around 22:03 UTC. Escalated to SEs, they're seeing retries from their app.

erica-oncall: oncall here, switching pager to me. quick status: gateway 502s with upstream connection reset & 504 gateway timeouts. no clear spikes in infra CPU or GPU.

bob_sre: digging into edge-proxy logs — there are lots of requests with empty request-id header. tracing shows a lot of requests bypassing sampling pipeline. could be lost request-ids causing missing spans.

alice.k: that's consistent with missing traces. If request-id is missing, our router doesn't attach context and some error paths early-return without logs.

charlie-prod: customer-impact: failures affect generation endpoints (text.generate) — estimated ~18k requests failed in 10m window. potential for retries causing downstream load.

dana-support: ack. I'm drafting a status to customers: brief note + ETA for mitigation.

bob_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) enable 100% trace sampling for gateway and inference-router for 15m; 2) temp middleware to log X-Request-ID and header dump for failed requests; 3) route traffic to dedicated pool fallback. prefer (1)+(2) now.

erica-oncall: agree. I can flip sampling but need sudo from deploy-bot / ops. anyone have the admin curl?

alice.k: admin endpoint that toggles sampling: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://ops.internal/api/observability/sampling -d '{"service":"gateway","rate":1.0}'
```

erica-oncall: running that now on gateway and inference-router (only in us-west-2).

incident-bot: Action: sampling rate set to 1.0 for services [gateway,inference-router] in region us-west-2 by erica-oncall at 1748888894.

bob_sre: enabled. please confirm traces started flowing. I'm tailing jaeger and logs for new spans.

alice.k: seeing new spans for previously missing requests. good.

charlie-prod: can we also temporarily add header-echo logging in gateway for 502 responses? small middleware to log request-id (or generate one if missing) and upstream status. we must be careful with PII — only headers and status.

bob_sre: prepared hotpatch for gateway config. small go middleware:
```
if req.Header.Get("X-Request-ID") == "" {
  req.Header.Set("X-Request-ID", generate())
}
log.Warnf("gateway: id=%s upstream=%s status=%d", req.Header.Get("X-Request-ID"), upstream, resp.StatusCode)
```

erica-oncall: can we canary to 5% traffic first? deploy-bot can do canary rollout.

deploy-bot: starting canary rollout: gateway-hotpatch v1 -> 5% traffic in us-west-2. expected completion 30s.

dana-support: customer comms updated: "We are investigating elevated API errors in us-west-2, mitigation in progress — we'll follow up within 30 minutes."

alice.k: after canary logs show request-ids generated and correlated with spans. but we still see a subset of errors that return before middleware runs — those are likely early LB failures. need deeper edge logs.

bob_sre: looking at edge-proxy configs — health-check amber for some upstream inference-router instances. connection reset errors correlate with instances on node group worker-a.

erica-oncall: rolling restart of worker-a group? that might clear stuck connections. any reason not to?

alice.k: safe to restart gradually 1/3 at a time. let's do rolling restart for the affected ASG. I'll coordinate.

charlie-prod: while restarts happen, consider fallback routing to dedicated-capacity for a subset of traffic to reduce customer impact. toggle route policy to send 10% of traffic to dedicated-pool-usw2.

bob_sre: I'm on it. updating routing policy now.

incident-bot: Routing policy updated: 10% traffic -> dedicated-pool-usw2 by bob_sre at 1748888908.

dana-support: customers notified of fallback routing. asking for logs from our two escalated customers to correlate.

alice.k: restarted one batch of worker-a nodes. connection resets dropped by ~60% on that batch. overall 5xx rate trending down to ~4%. good sign.

erica-oncall: keep sampling at 100% until we confirm full recovery, then ramp down to baseline. set an alert to remind to revert.

bob_sre: noted. adding a 20m timer to revert sampling to 0.05 after confirmation.

alice.k: one remaining pain: many historical traces are absent because request IDs weren't persisted in logs. we should add a stopgap to dump minimal request context for failed requests to object storage for 1h window. I can push a short-lived sink.

charlie-prod: approved. make sure encryption and retention settings are default. no PII.

alice.k: pushing sink now. snippet:
```
logger.WithFields("rid", req.Header.Get("X-Request-ID"), "path", req.URL.Path).Error("failure-snapshot")
// sink writes to obs-archive/failures/us-west-2/174888... ndjson compressed
```

deploy-bot: sink deployed to canary nodes.

dana-support: update sent to customers at 22:15 UTC — errors reduced, mitigation steps in progress, engineering investigating root cause, ETA next update 22:45 UTC.

erica-oncall: metrics look stable for 3 min, 5xx down to 2.1%. I'm going to hold on restarts until full batch completes.

bob_sre: follow-ups: 1) post-incident root cause: flaky upstream connections from worker-a nodes causing resets — need kernel/netstack tuning and connection backlog review; 2) low trace sampling & missing request-id worsened visibility — add guard to always generate request-id at edge; 3) improve dashboard alerts to include request-id absence ratio.

charlie-prod: create a runbook task list and hand off to eng-runtime for follow-up. Dana, prepare customer postmortem template for impacted tenants.

dana-support: will draft. adding notes on timeline and mitigation.

alice.k: adding follow-up tickets: ENG-obs-123: ensure X-Request-ID always set in edge (backport + test), ENG-net-456: connection backlog tuning + autoscaler review, ENG-obs-789: ephemeral sink for failed reqs as fallback logging.

erica-oncall: OK spinning down sampling to 20% for now, will monitor for 10m then revert to default.

incident-bot: Sampling schedule updated: gateway/inference-router -> 0.2 at 1748888923 by erica-oncall.

bob_sre: final check — 5xx steady ~1.8% and customer queues are stable. marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. we should keep the thread open for root cause.

charlie-prod: thanks everyone. great cross-team work.

alice.k: filing an RCA draft — will ping for review.

dana-support: filing customer follow-ups.

erica-oncall: handing back pager to rotation at 1748888925.

incident-bot: Incident Status: mitigation in place, monitoring. oncall erica-oncall -> handback at 1748888925.
